project: MenopauseWash.com product and affiliate candidate research
scope: US editorial comparison candidates. Public official product and program pages only; no applications, account access, purchases, messages or publication.

interpretation.include: Eligible for a factual external-cleanser comparison, subject to clinician/editorial review; not an endorsement of menopause-odor efficacy.
interpretation.research-only: Keep in internal ledger or evidence explainer; do not present as a proven odor treatment or default purchase recommendation.
interpretation.exclude: Exclude from fragrance-free/sensitive-vulva shortlist; may be discussed transparently in an ingredient comparison.
interpretation.supplements: All oral products remain research-only. Manufacturer pages establish labels and marketing claims, not clinical efficacy for menopause-related odor. Do not transfer evidence between species, strains, doses, formulations, routes or populations. These oral capsules/gummies are not suppositories.
interpretation.price: USD manufacturer snapshots, not Amazon prices; no stock, shipping, subscription or discount guarantee.
interpretation.rights: Public image URLs permit inspection, not assumed commercial reuse. Obtain licensed affiliate creative or manufacturer permission before publication. No product image was edited.

cleansers.name: Vanicream Gentle Body Wash
cleansers.access_depth: Product page opened; full directions and ingredients read; public manufacturer front image visually inspected locally.
cleansers.format_size: Liquid rinse-off body wash; inspected front bottle 12 fl oz / 355 mL.
cleansers.route: External hands/body; lather on wet skin and rinse. Manufacturer does not establish intravaginal use or menopause-specific efficacy.
cleansers.ingredients: Water, glycerin, coco-glucoside, propanediol, sodium cocoyl glycinate, acrylates copolymer, panthenol, caprylyl glycol, disodium EDTA, sodium chloride, 1,2-hexanediol, mica, titanium dioxide, sodium hydroxide, citric acid.
cleansers.fragrance: Brand cleanser page states no fragrance or masking fragrance. Bottle visibly says fragrance free. No essential oils/botanical extracts per product page.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: General skin cleanser, not a vaginal pH or infection treatment; suitability for any individual vulvar skin condition is not established by this page.

cleansers.name: Dove Ultra Sensitive Serum Body Wash with only 10 ingredients
cleansers.access_depth: Full product page and ingredient section read; public product image downloaded and visually inspected.
cleansers.format_size: Rinse-off gel body wash, 18.5 oz / 547 mL.
cleansers.route: External body cleansing; not an internal vaginal wash.
cleansers.ingredients: Water, cocamidopropyl betaine, sodium methyl lauroyl taurate, sodium chloride, glycerin, hydroxystearic acid, stearic acid, cocamide MEA, sodium benzoate, citric acid.
cleansers.fragrance: Explicitly fragrance-free; displayed ingredients omit fragrance.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Keep exact Ultra Sensitive variant identity. Ordinary Sensitive Body Wash is a different fragranced formula. No menopause-odor treatment evidence established.

cleansers.name: Dove Sensitive Body Wash
cleansers.access_depth: Current redirected official product page opened; full ingredients read; older indexed official FAQ additionally states contains fragrance.
cleansers.format_size: Rinse-off body wash; 20 oz page with 11 oz and 30.6 oz options.
cleansers.ingredients_facts: Ingredient list includes cocamidopropyl betaine, lauric acid, sodium lauroyl glycinate, sodium lauroyl isethionate, soybean oils, glycerin, Fragrance, BHT and iodopropynyl butylcarbamate.
cleansers.fragrance: Fragrance is explicitly listed. Hypoallergenic/sensitive branding does not make this fragrance-free.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Exclude from an unscented shortlist. Do not mislabel as Dove Sensitive Skin unscented; a bar and a body wash can have different formulas.

cleansers.name: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser
cleansers.access_depth: Official product page opened; free-of-added-fragrance feature and ingredient list read.
cleansers.format_size: Non-foaming facial cleanser; exact purchasable size not selected.
cleansers.route: External facial skin per page; not specifically labeled for vulva.
cleansers.ingredients_facts: Glycerin, cetearyl/stearyl/cetyl alcohols, PEG-40 stearate, ceramides NP/AP/EOP, sodium hyaluronate, cholesterol, phenoxyethanol; no fragrance in displayed list.
cleansers.fragrance: Manufacturer explicitly says free of added fragrance.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Potential general gentle-cleanser comparison, but avoid converting face-wash labeling into a vulvar recommendation without expert review. Formula can change; manufacturer directs customers to package ingredients.

cleansers.name: Good Clean Love Balance Moisturizing Wash
cleansers.access_depth: Official product page and ingredients opened; official FAQ indexed result read.
cleansers.format_size: Rinse-off wash; 8 oz full size and 1 oz travel options. Page displayed Sold out for visible selection.
cleansers.route: External intimate cleanser; do not infer internal use from vaginal microbiome marketing.
cleansers.ingredients_facts: Aloe juice, glycerin, surfactants, lactic acid, Natural Lavender Flavor, botanical extracts, potassium sorbate and sodium benzoate.
cleansers.fragrance: Contains natural lavender flavor; page expressly describes floral aroma. Free from synthetic/artificial fragrance does not mean fragrance-free. Official FAQ says lavender was always present and packaging was updated.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Exclude from fragrance-free shortlist. Brand pH, microbiome, irritation and odor assertions are not independent efficacy evidence; avoid importing marketing assertions into site conclusions.

cleansers.name: Vagisil Menopause Support Probiotic Mousse Wash
cleansers.access_depth: Official product page opened, full ingredients and usage read; manufacturer side-label photo downloaded and visually reviewed.
cleansers.format_size: Foaming mousse pump; exact size not read from selected side image.
cleansers.route: For external use only; apply and rinse thoroughly.
cleansers.ingredients_facts: Cocamidopropyl betaine, Lactobacillus Ferment, sodium hyaluronate, lauryl glucoside, glycerin, lactic acid, octenidine HCl, phenoxyethanol, Fragrance (among full list).
cleansers.fragrance: CONFLICT: official page at lines 124 says Free from fragrance, dyes, and sulfates; same page feature at line 103 says Light botanical scent and ingredient list at line 169 ends Fragrance. Side-label photo also reads Light botanical scent.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Treat as fragranced pending manufacturer reconciliation, not fragrance-free. Lactobacillus Ferment does not establish live probiotic organisms/CFU. pH 5.5 and 24-hour odor marketing do not establish treatment efficacy.

cleansers.name: Love Wellness pH Balanced Cleanser
cleansers.access_depth: Official page and ingredient image opened; manufacturer ingredient image downloaded and visually transcribed; no fragrance/essential-oil statement and consumer-study footnote checked.
cleansers.format_size: External intimate gel cleanser, 5 fl oz standard.
cleansers.route: Apply a dime-sized amount with clean hands to vulva, lather gently and rinse; page advises against loofah/sponge/towel.
cleansers.ingredients_facts: Aloe barbadensis leaf juice, disodium/sodium cocoyl glutamate, decyl glucoside, citric acid, Chondrus crispus extract (carrageenan), calendula flower extract, gluconolactone, xanthan gum, benzyl alcohol, sodium benzoate, tetrasodium glutamate diacetate, acacia senegal gum.
cleansers.fragrance: Manufacturer explicitly says no fragrance or essential oils; inspected ingredient image has no parfum/fragrance. Benzyl alcohol appears in ingredients; ingredient-function/individual sensitivity questions remain separate from fragrance-free marketing.
cleansers.cautions_claim_gaps: Brand cites a consumer-perception study, 31 women aged 23–64 for four weeks. Do not present reported lack of pH disruption as objective proof or menopause-specific effectiveness.
cleansers.price_context: One-time purchase, 5 fl oz; separate introductory subscription offer shown.
cleansers.front_photo_status: Official manufacturer image downloaded and visually inspected. Commercial reuse permission unknown; review reference only.

oral_supplements.name: repHresh Pro-B Vaginal Probiotic Supplement
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official product page opened, FAQ and directions read; physical package insert not inspected.
oral_supplements.format_route: Oral capsule, one per day; NOT a gummy or intravaginal product.
oral_supplements.label_facts: 5 billion beneficial bacteria per serving; L. rhamnosus GR-1 and L. reuteri RC-14 identified in official FAQ. Vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free claims.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: Full excipients/insert not verified. Do not conflate Pro-B with repHresh vaginal gel. Strain studies require separate population/outcome appraisal; no menopause-odor outcome established here.
oral_supplements.front_photo_status: Official manufacturer image downloaded and visually inspected. Commercial reuse permission unknown; review reference only.

oral_supplements.name: O Positiv URO Vaginal Probiotic Capsules
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official product page opened; ingredient facts and one-time price read.
oral_supplements.format_route: Two oral capsules daily with water; 30 servings / 60 capsules.
oral_supplements.label_facts: V-Positiv blend 50 mg, 5 billion CFU total: L. acidophilus, L. rhamnosus, L. reuteri, L. fermentum. XOS 400 mg. Other ingredients maltodextrin, vegetarian cellulose capsule, natural color.
oral_supplements.strain_identifiers: Species only in retrieved ingredient panel; no alphanumeric strain IDs given.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: Species names cannot establish equivalence to GR-1/RC-14 trials. Proprietary blend does not disclose per-species CFU. Manufacturer odor/pH claims are not independently validated here. Not the URO gummy formulation.
oral_supplements.price_context: One-time single bottle; $26.99 monthly delivery separately displayed.

oral_supplements.name: O Positiv URO Vaginal Probiotic Gummy Vitamins, Pink Pineapple
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official product page, ingredient facts and format-comparison FAQ read; front bottle photo visually inspected.
oral_supplements.format_route: Two oral gummies daily; 60 gummies / 30 servings; adults 18+.
oral_supplements.label_facts: Bacillus coagulans SNZ 1969, 1 billion CFU in 135 mg proprietary blend with pineapple fruit powder and sea-buckthorn juice powder. Vitamin C 45 mg, vitamin D3 50 mcg, sodium 5 mg. Tapioca syrup, sugar, pectin, natural flavor and color among excipients.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: Different organism, dose and added vitamins from URO capsules; no borrowed capsule efficacy claims. Vegetarian but not vegan per manufacturer because vitamin D source. Check total vitamin D across supplements and full label with clinician as relevant. Brand advises clinician consultation for medication use, medical conditions, pregnancy/nursing or supplement combinations.
oral_supplements.price_context: One-time bottle; $27.99 recurring monthly option separately displayed.

oral_supplements.name: Culturelle Women's Probiotics + Multivitamin Gummies
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official page/FAQ read; supplement-facts image downloaded and visually transcribed.
oral_supplements.label_facts: Label: 7.5 mg probiotic blend / 1 billion CFU of Bacillus coagulans and Bacillus subtilis; no strain IDs. Two gummies, 30 servings, 3 g added sugar. Vitamins A/C/D/E/K2, B1/B2/B3/B6/folate/B12/biotin/B5, calcium, zinc, selenium; sodium separately. D3 20 mcg. Cane sugar, corn syrup, water, natural flavor, pectin, citric acid, fruit/vegetable juice color.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: General digestive/immune/multivitamin product, no menopause-odor efficacy established. Label supports 16 named vitamins/minerals, while FAQ says 15; wrong capsule paragraph mentions LGG/CECT 8145. Ignore that mismatched capsule copy. Current physical package still should be matched before purchase. Dairy-free formula made in facility handling dairy per image.

oral_supplements.name: Love Wellness Good Girl Probiotics
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official product page and study footnote read; supplement-facts image downloaded and visually transcribed.
oral_supplements.format_route: One oral capsule daily, preferably with meal; 30 capsules.
oral_supplements.label_facts: 50 mg proprietary blend, 1 billion CFU total: B. subtilis DE111 plus L. acidophilus, gasseri, salivarius, brevis, rhamnosus, casei, plantarum, paracasei. Other ingredients inulin, HPMC capsule and medium-chain triglycerides. Only DE111 has an alphanumeric strain identifier on inspected panel.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: 90% freshness claim comes from consumer-perception study of 33 women 18+, six weeks; not an objective microbiome measurement or menopause-specific randomized trial. New formula is 1 capsule/9 organisms, not older 2-capsule version. Manufacturer advises clinician consultation before supplement use.
oral_supplements.price_context: One-time 30 count; $14.99 introductory subscription separately shown.
oral_supplements.front_photo_status: Official manufacturer image downloaded and visually inspected. Commercial reuse permission unknown; review reference only.

oral_supplements.name: Happy V Prebiotic + Probiotic
oral_supplements.access_depth: Official product page opened; complete supplement facts, excipients and one-time price read.
oral_supplements.format_route: Two oral capsules per serving; 30 servings / 60 capsules.
oral_supplements.label_facts: 20 billion CFU total: L. acidophilus LA-14 8B, B. lactis HN019 3B, L. rhamnosus HN001 2B, L. crispatus CCFM1110 2B, L. gasseri HLG13 2B, L. reuteri HR7 2B, B. subtilis DE111 1B. Biotin 30 mcg; PreforPro bacteriophage blend 15 mg. Rice flour, vegetable magnesium stearate, bamboo silicon dioxide, hypromellose capsule.
oral_supplements.cautions_claim_gaps: Strain transparency is comparatively useful, but does not establish that this full product treats menopausal odor. Claims based on individual strains cannot automatically be attributed to the seven-strain finished formula. Do not copy brand language about resolving infections.
oral_supplements.price_context: One-time bottle; subscription prices/temporary sale separate.
oral_supplements.photo_use_rights: Terms indexed on official site restrict commercial copying/public display; use approved partner assets only.

disclosure.ftc_access_depth: Official guidance opened and affiliate-marketing section read.
disclosure.ftc_summary: Disclose commission relationship clearly and conspicuously close to recommendation/link. Affiliate link or Buy now alone is not adequate; Paid link next to link can identify nature. A linked disclosure page alone is insufficient.
disclosure.proposed_when_enrolled_copy: We may earn a commission when you buy through links on this page.
disclosure.amazon_exact_statement: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
disclosure.amazon_notes: Official page requires statement clearly/conspicuously on site plus legally compliant disclosure near links/reviews. Do not assert Associate status before enrollment. This is a researched implementation checklist, not legal advice or completed compliance review.
